title: Real form of the complete quadratic function
statement: For each $n\in\mathbb{N}$, identify the Boolean cube $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ with the sign cube $\{\pm1\}^n$ coordinatewise, and encode a bit $b$ by the sign $(-1)^b$. The real-valued function obtained by viewing the sign-encoded complete quadratic Boolean function on $\{\pm1\}^n$ equals the complete quadratic function transported to that sign cube.
